subject: [PATCH v3 1/3] mm: page_alloc: add a watermark check that knows the migratetype

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function __zone_watermark_ok_mt() to the Linux kernel's page allocation system, which takes into account the migratetype of the request when checking if an allocation can succeed. The function is used in several places where the caller needs to know whether the allocation will honor ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT requests. The patch also moves the declaration of __zone_watermark_ok() to mm/page_alloc.h and makes no functional changes yet, as it's a preparation for future changes that will make the high-order check respect ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT requests.
